title: Navy Blue Account: Mobile Deposits and Daily Limits
summary: Covers Navy Blue Account mobile check deposits (daily mobile deposit limit $5,000 and need clear images per app instructions), digital transfer limits (daily transfer limit $25,000 and split across business days if exceeding), and out-of-network ATM fee rebates (monthly cap 10, applied to qualifying surcharge amounts). Includes best practices for deposit timing and retaining original checks until posting.
